name: Suntex Enterprises, Inc.
summary: Suntex Enterprises, Inc., an alternative energy company, engages in the production and distribution of renewable biodiesel fuel. It also offers biodiesel production equipment and technology. Sunx's biodiesel is used in compression-ignition engines. The company was formerly known as Macrosonic, Inc. Suntex Enterprises, Inc. is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.
